answer: Put a fresh visual CAPTCHA at first payout, not at account creation. Each claim receives a random diagram; the solver must identify the route where a falcon crosses a dune without touching an onyx marker. The verifier accepts one answer per nonce, then consumes it, so aliases need separate solves. Proposed human-check fee: 0.01 POA per identity; 0.01 × 1,000 = 10 POA for 1,000 fake keys, versus 0.01 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: CAPTCHA farms and multimodal models can still automate solutions.
